```{=html}
<div class="lukb-dashboard">

  <!-- Header Section -->
  <header class="lukb-header">
    <div class="lukb-header-top">
      <div class="lukb-title-group">
        <h1>Makro- & Zentralbank-Dashboard</h1>
        <p>Wöchentlicher Konjunkturkalender, 3-Jahres-Prognosen und Notenbank-Zeitstrahl</p>
      </div>
      <div class="lukb-header-actions">
        <button type="button" id="btn-export-pdf" class="lukb-btn-export" title="Erzeuge 1-seitiges A4-PDF mit allen Tabellen">
          <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"></path><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="18" x2="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="9" y1="15" x2="15" y2="15"></line></svg>
          A4-Report (PDF)
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- OBERER BEREICH: 2-SPALTIG (LINKS: KONJUNKTURDATEN | RECHTS: PROGNOSEN) -->
  <div class="lukb-grid-2col">
    
    <!-- LINKS: KONJUNKTURDATEN DER LAUFENDEN WOCHE -->
    <section id="section-macro" class="lukb-card">
      <div class="lukb-card-header">
        <h2 class="lukb-card-title">
          <span class="icon">📅</span>
          Konjunkturdaten der laufenden Woche
        </h2>
        <div class="lukb-controls">
          <select id="filter-macro-country" class="lukb-select">
            <option value="all">Alle Länder / Regionen</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <!-- Dynamic Table Container -->
      <div class="lukb-card-body">
        <div id="macro-table-container"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="lukb-footer-note">
        <span>Datenquelle: LUKB, LSEG</span>
        <span>Laufende Woche</span>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- RECHTS: BIP- & INFLATIONSPROGNOSEN -->
    <section id="section-forecasts" class="lukb-card">
      <div class="lukb-card-header">
        <h2 class="lukb-card-title">
          <span class="icon">📊</span>
          BIP- und Inflationsprognosen
        </h2>
      </div>

      <!-- Dynamic Forecasts Table Container -->
      <div class="lukb-card-body">
        <div id="forecasts-table-container"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="lukb-footer-note">
        <span>Quelle: LUKB Research & Consensus</span>
        <span>Ausblick 2025–2027</span>
      </div>
    </section>

  </div>

  <!-- UNTERER BEREICH: ZENTRALBANKEN-ZEITSTRAHL (VOLLBREITE) -->
  <section id="section-cb" class="lukb-card berry-top">
    <div class="lukb-card-header">
      <h2 class="lukb-card-title">
        <span class="icon">🏛️</span>
        Zentralbank-Zinsentscheide (Zeitstrahl)
      </h2>
      <div class="lukb-controls">
        <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">Proportionale Timeline (heute - 30 Tage bis Ende 2027)</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Checkbox Filter Panel for Banks -->
    <div class="cb-checkbox-filter-panel">
      <div class="cb-checkbox-header">
        <span>Zentralbanken auswählen:</span>
        <div class="cb-quick-actions">
          <button type="button" id="cb-select-default" class="cb-quick-link">Standard (G5)</button>
          <span>•</span>
          <button type="button" id="cb-select-all" class="cb-quick-link">Alle auswählen</button>
          <span>•</span>
          <button type="button" id="cb-select-none" class="cb-quick-link">Keine</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="cb-checkbox-grid" class="cb-checkbox-grid">
        <!-- Dynamically rendered checkbox chips with sharp borders -->
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Timeline View Container directly -->
    <div id="cb-view-timeline" class="lukb-card-body" style="padding: 16px 20px;">
      <div id="cb-timeline-container"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="lukb-footer-note">
      <span>Auswahl: SNB, US Fed, EZB, BoJ, BoE, BoC, RBA, Norges Bank, Riksbank, RBNZ</span>
      <span>Interaktiver Zeitstrahl: Horizontales Scrollen & Tooltip bei Mouseover</span>
    </div>
  </section>

</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdfmake/0.2.10/pdfmake.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdfmake/0.2.10/vfs_fonts.js"></script>
<script src="assets/app.js"></script>
```
